data.narrative: Learner demonstrated exemplary incident triage and debugging discipline throughout Module 01. Accurately disproved external dependency failure via container health checks, identified Pydantic configuration naming drift, diagnosed and resolved an off-by-one pagination defect, and articulated deep relational set semantics regarding non-deterministic ordering and offset drift under concurrent writes.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated precise, testable, refutable hypotheses before executing code or modifying configuration across all failure scenarios.
dimension_scores.evidence: Hypothesis A (database unavailable) vs Hypothesis B (environment contract mismatch); Hypothesis A (position drift under newest-first inserts) vs Hypothesis B (unstable tie-breaking and snapshot inconsistency).

dimension_scores.observation: Consistently looked past deceptive symptoms to isolate systemic root causes, differentiating ORM connection failure from config naming and offset arithmetic from relational set ordering.
dimension_scores.evidence: Noted 'Symptoms describe what failed from the thrower perspective, not the true cause... offset pagination assumes the ordered dataset remains stable between requests'.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed empirical boundary tests and concurrent load simulations to prove invariants rather than relying on static code inspection.
dimension_scores.evidence: Constructed multi-page curl probes identifying the 10-row initial skip and validated concurrent pagination stability using api/scripts/test_concurrent_pagination.py.

dimension_scores.observation: Used independent diagnostic tooling (Docker inspect, direct SQL queries, process logs) to disprove hypotheses before touching application code.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified linkops-postgres container health and port binding to eliminate database outage before inspecting api/.env.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated mature understanding of database concurrency, relational ordering invariants, and the fundamental limitations of offset pagination compared to keyset pagination.
dimension_scores.evidence: Highlighted that test verified insert-only scenario with ORDER BY id ASC, but keyset pagination is required for mutation-stable feeds under deletes, updates, or descending order.

strengths: Uncompromising hypothesis discipline that prevents chasing symptoms and avoids shotgun debugging
Deep architectural insight into relational database engine mechanics, execution plans, and concurrency hazards
Methodical verification using automated scripts and concurrent stress testing
growth_areas: Apply this diagnostic rigor to log stream parsing, structured JSON logging, and correlation IDs in Module 02
data.recommendation: In Module 02 ('Reading Logs Like a Story'), leverage structured log attributes and trace correlation to reconstruct incident timelines before querying database state.

public_evidence.title: Module 01: Hypothesis-First Debugging & Root Cause Isolation
public_evidence.description: Resolved startup crash and pagination concurrency anomalies in LinkOps API
